queries.sql: SELECT 'EVENT_20161' source,created_at observed_at FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161 UNION ALL SELECT 'RECEIPT_38',created_at FROM programacion.provenance_receipts WHERE id=38 UNION ALL SELECT codigo,primera_vez FROM transversal.error_knowledge WHERE codigo IN('IG-M107-SOAK-CRITERION-DRIFT-001','IG-M107-CP2-READ-ROLE-CURRENTNESS-001') ORDER BY observed_at;
queries.result: temporal sequence: event 20161 Oct-04; receipt38 Oct-07; two EKB validations Oct-14.

queries.sql: WITH hist AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller FROM public.lf_eventos l,jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161), cur AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname fullname,p.proname FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN('programacion','public','lf_ops') AND p.proname ~ '(input_governance|input_readiness|guard_input)') SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.caller IS NULL) complement_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.caller IS NULL AND c.proname ~ '(queue|direct_step|handoff|continuation|_ctx|cached_v2)') path_shape_candidates FROM cur c LEFT JOIN hist h ON h.caller=c.fullname;
queries.result: 64 current name-pattern complement functions outside historical caller identity set; 23 have queue/direct/handoff/continuation/ctx/cached_v2 shapes; candidate signal only.

assumptions: later records may refine interpretation but cannot rewrite earlier observation time
name pattern is candidate discovery, not caller proof

findings.claim: Evidence authority is temporally layered; later receipt/EKB evidence refines but does not rewrite the Oct-04 snapshot.
64 current complement functions, including 23 path-shaped names, are candidates requiring reference/lifecycle classification; they are not 64 proven omissions.

negative_tests.hypothesis: Later evidence can be treated as same-time P0 evidence.
